items.title: DexCom listed as ransomware victim
items.summary: The US glucose-monitoring maker was posted as a victim attributed to the Redact actor; no company confirmation found yet.

items.title: Andersen Group hit by SilentRansomGroup
items.summary: Tracker reports system disruption and a payment demand attributed to SilentRansomGroup.

items.title: Osaka Public University shuts ~500 servers
items.summary: Attack on Oct 2 suspended classes into the following week; possible leak of addresses, emails and phone numbers under investigation.

items.title: All Business Technologies / Fox Hill bookkeeping claimed by n0n
items.summary: Tax and bookkeeping practice listed Oct 18 by the n0n group; status is claimed only.

items.title: Solid Trading B.V. (NL) claimed by n0n
items.summary: Dutch firm listed Oct 18 by n0n in the same batch; unverified by the victim.

items.title: September claimed-victim volume up ~30% year over year
items.summary: Monthly tallies put September 2026 at roughly 790 claimed victims, continuing the 2026 climb led by Qilin.

ransomware.note: Victim names come from leak-site trackers and are not yet confirmed by the victims themselves.

items.title: Azure gateway and AI services outages across 18 regions
items.summary: Two Azure incidents between Sep 29 and Oct 1 took gateway and AI services offline in 18 regions.

items.title: Azure DevOps Australia core-services reports
items.summary: StatusGator logged two separate Australia core-services incidents for Azure DevOps within 24 hours around Oct 15.

items.title: AWS legacy services enter maintenance mode today
items.summary: Per AWS's Sep 29 notice, several legacy services stop accepting new customers from Oct 29 — a planned change, not an outage; check dependencies.

outage.note: No major confirmed hyperscaler outage found for mid-to-late October; items are secondary-source reports.

items.title: CISA adds six CVEs to KEV (Plex, Siemens, SiteGuard)
items.summary: Oct 20 additions cover Plex Media Server, Siemens Software Center and EG Secure Solutions SiteGuard Server Edition.

items.title: KEV passes 247 additions for 2026 by October 1
items.summary: More entries already than all of 2025; median time to fully remediate a KEV flaw has risen to 43 days per the 2026 DBIR.

items.title: September zero-day roundup: Drupal, Gitea, N-able
items.summary: Monthly report lists exploited flaws in Drupal, Gitea and N-able, all flagged as KEV.

cyber.note: No October data-breach disclosure tied to a KEV zero-day surfaced in today's search.

items.title: Typhoon Champi nears Taiwan
items.summary: Powerful typhoon approached Taiwan around Oct 22, triggering flight cancellations.

items.title: Hurricane Simon strikes Mexico as Category 4
items.summary: Coastal residents felt Simon's effects as it swept in off the Mexican Pacific coast around Oct 11.

items.title: Hurricane Isaias lands in Florida, at least 4 dead
items.summary: Isaias made landfall in Florida as a Category 2 around Oct 10.

items.title: M 6.9 — 197 km WNW of Port-Olry, Vanuatu
items.summary: Oct 24; tsunami flag set, USGS PAGER green.

items.title: M 6.5 — Bonin Islands, Japan region
items.summary: Oct 25; tsunami flag set, USGS PAGER green.

items.title: M 6.4 — southeast of Easter Island
items.summary: Oct 29; no tsunami, USGS PAGER green.

items.title: M 6.3 — 170 km NW of Port-Olry, Vanuatu
items.summary: Oct 24 companion event; no tsunami, USGS PAGER green.

physical.note: Storm items come from news video listings and are unverified; confirm against NHC / JTWC. No October wildfire or flood reports surfaced.
